name: GuestFolioDisputeDesk
tagline: Folio disputes, credits and chargebacks – approved within limits, evidenced and on time.
description: A complete hotel credit-office app for Power Apps and Power Pages: guest billing disputes, folio adjustments and card chargebacks with a delegation-of-authority approval ladder, write-off control, reason-code evidence checklists, guest-reply SLA and chargeback deadlines, and loss-risk scoring.
features: Approval limits per role with write-off role
Evidence checklist per reason code with completeness %
Representment blocked below the evidence threshold or after the deadline
Guest-reply SLA and chargeback response deadlines
Chargeback win rate by card brand
Bulk move / assign / export with undo
Power Fx outputs and OnSelect / OnChange / OnCreate / OnSave / OnAction / OnStatusChange events
controlType: standard (2 controls: GuestFolioDisputeDesk data set + GuestFolioDisputeDeskPortal field control)
